findings.text: follow-on: the added fleet_migrate._local_request duplicates the capability dispatch._write_fleet_request already owns - the same os.open(fifo, O_WRONLY|O_NONBLOCK) retry-until-deadline loop, write and close for the supervisor request FIFO - so the repository now carries two writers and two names for one FIFO (dispatch.FLEET_FIFO_NAME and fleet_supervisor.REQUEST_FIFO_NAME, both "requests"). The addition extends the owner only by tolerating ENOENT while the FIFO has no reader yet; extracting one shared writer, or having _local_request call the dispatch owner, would remove the fork.
